content.title: The Mongoose
content.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

Title: The Mongoose

Overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

Genres: Action, Thriller

Production Companies: Code Entertainment, The Solution

Production Countries: United States of America

Spoken Languages: English
